description: Monte Carlo portfolio Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall over a one-factor correlated-asset model. Integer-only xoshiro256** PRNG and fixed-point arithmetic run the full path simulation, so a declared seed replays byte-identically, and a tampered seed produces a different hash. Declares the SPEC.md §24.6.2 seeded-stochastic determinism class; the PRNG algorithm, seed, and draw count are carried in the receipt as ordinary inputs/outputs.
cycle_preflight: FAST - 62,559,977 user_cycles at proved vector 2 of 6 (vector-own-inputs; n_assets 2, n_paths 100, 3,600 uniform draws), measured exec-only 2026-09-18 against these guarded bytes (sha256:5e03b986ab0189445180af9d2785a508b95bc0f3ae47c68b24d462066c0b42cc); production-scale vector 0 remains ~21.5 G user_cycles (SLOW; pre-guard measurement 21,516,388,936 max across all vectors, argmax v4), resumable from the kept 20.6% checkpoint as an optional later upgrade. Honesty line: This receipt attests execution of published fixture vector 2 (3,600 uniform draws), not the production-scale vector 0 (1,320,000 draws); freshness and recompute-equality are satisfied by any published vector; a vector-0 receipt is an optional later upgrade.
